description: Look up a filing or exhibit by its SEC accession number. Supports both dashed format (e.g., "0001193125-22-010026") and compact 18-digit format. Returns filing metadata including company name, form type, filing date, and exhibit count. If the filing is in the local database, returns full metadata; if only found on SEC EDGAR, returns basic metadata with an isInDatabase: false flag.

accessionNumber.description: SEC accession number in dashed (e.g., "0001193125-22-010026") or compact 18-digit format
